name: contextforge-sample-v1
description: Hand-labelled queries over the bundled synthetic corpus (sample_data/). Relevance is defined by evidence strings: a chunk is relevant if it belongs to a listed source and contains an evidence string. Categories are stratified to probe lexical matching, paraphrase (semantic) matching, entity aliases, relationship (multi-hop) questions and unanswerable questions. Every third query is in the dev split; only the dev split may be used for tuning.
